cases.translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jonah.
cases.explain: The phrase 'word of God' uses the genitive Господа to express possession.

cases.sentence: Собирайся, ступай в великий ___ Ниневию и возвести там.
cases.translation: Rise up, go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim.
cases.explain: The preposition в with accusative indicates movement or direction into a location.

cases.translation: The people of Nineveh believed in God.
cases.explain: The verb поверили (believed in) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: И все, от большого до малого, оделись в ___.
cases.translation: And all, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.
cases.explain: The preposition в with accusative indicates putting on or covering oneself.
The preposition до (up to, reaching) governs the genitive case.
The preposition со (from) in the sense of 'from off' governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Пусть каждый изо всех сил призывает ___.
cases.translation: Let everyone call upon God with all their might.
cases.explain: The verb призывает (calls upon) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть они оставят свои злые пути и ___.
cases.translation: Let them turn from their evil ways and violence.
cases.explain: The verb оставить (leave behind, abandon) takes the accusative case for direct objects.

reading.ru: И было к Ионе слово Господнее во второй раз.
reading.question: How many times had the word of the Lord come to Jonah?
reading.explain: The text says the word of the Lord came 'во второй раз' (the second time).

reading.question: How large was Nineveh?
options: A city taking one day to cross
reading.explain: The text states 'Ниневия была огромным городом' (Nineveh was an exceedingly great city).

reading.ru: Обойти ее можно было только за три дня.
reading.question: How long did it take to cross through Nineveh?
reading.explain: The text says it took only three days to go across the city.

reading.ru: Ниневитяне поверили Богу и объявили пост.
reading.question: What did the people of Nineveh do after Jonah's preaching?
options: They believed God and proclaimed a fast
reading.correct: They believed God and proclaimed a fast
reading.explain: The text states 'Ниневитяне поверили Богу и объявили пост' (The people believed God and proclaimed a fast).

reading.ru: Он велел объявить в Неневии указ царя и его приближенных.
reading.question: What did the king of Nineveh proclaim throughout the city?
options: A decree of the king and his nobles
An order to execute the prophet
reading.correct: A decree of the king and his nobles
reading.explain: The text says the king proclaimed 'указ царя и его приближенных' (the decree of the king and his nobles).

reading.ru: Когда Бог увидел то, что они сделали, и как они оставили свои злые пути, Он смилостивился и не стал насылать на них беду.
reading.question: What did God do when He saw the people's repentance?
options: He had mercy and did not bring the disaster
reading.correct: He had mercy and did not bring the disaster
reading.explain: The text says 'Он смилостивился и не стал насылать на них беду' (He had mercy and did not bring the disaster).
